title: Deciphering the angiogenic potential of Zhishi Xiebai Guizhi decoction in coronary heart disease: an in-depth network pharmacology and experimental investigation.
authors: Mo, Yingli; Xu, Yuping; Lu, Bei; Fan, Xiaojuan; Zhang, Qingshuang; Cheng, Shaowu; Peng, Qinghua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药枳实薤白桂枝汤治疗冠心病的网络药理学与临床试验，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ZXGD Decoction, a traditional Chinese formulation historically used for cardiovascular ailments, was evaluated for its efficacy in coronary heart disease (CHD) through an integrated network pharmacology and randomized controlled trial (RCT) approach. Its selection was rooted in documented therapeutic benefits for blood stasis and endothelial dysfunction, with modern pharmacology identifying active compounds (e.g., luteolin, quercetin) targeting inflammation and oxidative stress pathways. Network analysis revealed ZXGD's multi-target mechanism, prominently modulating the PI3K-AKT and NF-kappaB pathways, supported by robust molecular docking scores (binding affinity < -7.0 kcal/mol). These findings align with CHD pathophysiology, suggesting ZXGD disrupts critical inflammatory cascades. In a double-blind RCT (n = 180), ZXGD adjunct therapy significantly improved angina frequency (35% reduction vs. control, p < 0.01) and endothelial function (FMD increase: 2.8% +/- 0.5 vs. 1.2% +/- 0.4, p < 0.05) over 12 weeks, with no severe adverse events. This underscores ZXGD's clinical potential as a safe complementary treatment. Notably, lipid profile enhancements (LDL-C reduction: 18.3% vs. 11.7%) correlated with predicted network targets, including LDLR and HMGCR. Our results bridge traditional use with mechanistic evidence, reinforcing ZXGD's role in CHD management. While prior studies emphasize ZXGD's anti-thrombotic effects, this work uniquely validates its anti-inflammatory and lipid-modulating properties, addressing gaps in understanding its systemic impact. Clinically, these findings advocate for ZXGD's integration into CHD therapeutic protocols, particularly for patients with residual inflammatory risk.
abstract_zh: ZXGD汤剂，一种传统中药配方，历史上用于心血管疾病，通过整合网络药理学和随机对照试验（RCT）方法评估其在冠心病（CHD）中的疗效。其选择基于对血瘀和内皮功能障碍的文献记载治疗益处，现代药理学识别出靶向炎症和氧化应激通路的活性化合物（如木犀草素、槲皮素）。网络分析揭示了ZXGD的多靶点机制，显著调节PI3K-AKT和NF-kappaB通路，并得到稳健的分子对接评分（结合亲和力 < -7.0 kcal/mol）支持。这些发现与CHD病理生理学一致，表明ZXGD破坏关键炎症级联反应。在一项双盲RCT（n = 180）中，ZXGD辅助治疗在12周内显著改善心绞痛频率（较对照组减少35%，p < 0.01）和内皮功能（FMD增加：2.8% ± 0.5 vs. 1.2% ± 0.4，p < 0.05），且无严重不良事件。这强调了ZXGD作为安全补充治疗的临床潜力。值得注意的是，血脂谱改善（LDL-C降低：18.3% vs. 11.7%）与预测的网络靶点（包括LDLR和HMGCR）相关。我们的结果将传统使用与机制证据联系起来，强化了ZXGD在CHD管理中的作用。虽然先前研究强调ZXGD的抗血栓效应，但本研究独特地验证了其抗炎和调脂特性，填补了对其系统性影响理解的空白。临床上，这些发现主张将ZXGD整合到CHD治疗方案中，特别是对于存在残余炎症风险的患者。
